# HADocs HASK Scoring Boundary Report

HADocs production score inputs are Findings with penalty, confidence, severity, category and suppression. HASK supporting, contradicting and missing evidence, applicability conflicts and partial verification have no established production conversion. Any conversion would change scoring semantics. The pilot therefore reports dry-run inputs only: knowledge weight remains metadata, missing/unknown/conflict never become negative evidence, partial verification never confirms, and no Finding or score delta is produced.
